responsibility: Zhongkui's entrance stops the bully and changes the sister from fear to guarded safety.

actors.objective: force the bully to release control without approaching the sister as a threat

phases.name: preparation
phases.visible_change: torso compresses behind the door while the hand control remains low

phases.name: primary-action
phases.visible_change: central control advances and the right arm opens into a halt gesture

phases.name: exact-hold
phases.visible_change: body and halt palm stop on the percussion accent

phases.name: reaction
phases.visible_change: head and torso soften toward the sister after the bully recoils

phases.name: settle
phases.visible_change: arm lowers while the body remains between sister and bully

actors.objective: retain control until the entrance breaks his confidence

phases.name: attention-change
phases.visible_change: head and chest turn from sister to the entrance

phases.name: reaction
phases.visible_change: weight shifts back and the forward hand retracts

phases.name: settle
phases.visible_change: rear foot catches the body in a defensive silhouette

observed_performance: bully reaction lands after the hold
presentation motion is not required for readability
rendered_review.notes: Readable muted; sound adds identity and weight.
